event: He says, "Hi there! I'm Alan. Isn't this a great place to get some exercise and fresh air?"
"The BEST place," she says, beaming. "Travelers, say hi to Alan!"

changes.note: Closeness scoring: validation and acknowledgment 1 each

event: She gives the camera a wave on his behalf, then turns it back to herself.
"Real trees, real dirt, real air. That's the quest. Hydrate, heroes! See you next time!"
She taps the screen to stop recording and lets out a happy breath.
"Sorry, sorry, I totally ambushed you. I'm Aelwyn."
"Most people turn back down by the creek. You came all the way up here. Respect."

memory.fact: Most hikers turn back down by the creek, short of the pine clearing high up Rock Canyon.
